player_prompt.intro:
Akwaaba Lights Out! Wɔde {size}x{size} grid of lights ama wo.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛmaa dɔnko no nyinaa OFF (a wɔgye di sɛ '.')
Berɛ a wo bɛpɛ dɔnko bi, ɛno bɛsesa ne ho ne ne nɔma a ɛbɛn no (soro/ase/benkum/nifa).
To [row col] sɛ wo pɛ dɔnko bi (0-indexed, enti range a ɛfata ne 0-{max_index}).
Wo wɔ {max_turns} moves sɛ wo bɛtumi asesa puzzle no.
Nsɛm a wɔka: 'O' = dɔnko no wɔ ON, '.' = dɔnko no wɔ OFF

board.current_state:
Hɔnkyɛn bɔ hyɛn mu (Tɔ {moves_made}, {moves_left} tɔ nkae, {completion}% hyɛn mu):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛwɔ sɛ wɔde ɔfã a wɔato din [row col] ma no, na ɛhwɛ mu no nkyekyɛmu ne nsensan yɛ akontabuo firi 0 kɔsi {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates no bɛyɛ fi 0 kɔsi {max_index}. Wo deɛ wo bɔɔ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Anigyesɛm! Woadi nsɛnnennen no ho dwuma wɔ {moves_used} akwan mu!
